# Philosophy

* We are **not** trying to re-invent the wheel. We will only publish resources that are unique or possess a distinct advantage over others.

* We are **not** pundits in any sense of the word. We will leave subjective analysis of the game to those who focus on that.

* Strive for simplicity and elegance.


# Dark Mode

This website has a dark mode switch in the navigation bar. It serves two purposes:

* Switches the site to having light text on a black background.

* Additional content will show source code and other technical information surrounding how the tools are made.

This was done because there is probably a fair intersection between those who like dark mode and those who like programming!
